schema_toml:
# 中药学（第六版 · 钟赣生 / 杨柏灿 主编）
# 加一门学科只需要这一份 TOML，不改任何 Rust 代码。
id = "materia-medica"
name = "中药学"
version = 1
description = "药群共性做基座，每味药只挂差异标签；功效当索引，应用由功效推；危险区原样记。"

[[entities]]
kind = "herb"
label = "药物"
primary = "name"
group_kind = "group"

[[entities.fields]]
key = "name"
label = "药名"
kind = "text"
indexable = true
required = true

[[entities.fields]]
key = "group_name"
label = "药群"
kind = "text"
indexable = true

[[entities.fields]]
key = "effects"
label = "功效"
kind = "tags"
indexable = true
reversible = true
weight = 2.0

[[entities.fields]]
key = "indications"
label = "应用"
kind = "tags"
indexable = true
reversible = true

[[entities.fields]]
key = "features"
label = "特点锚"
kind = "tags"
indexable = true
reversible = true
weight = 1.5

[[entities.fields]]
key = "contraindications"
label = "禁忌"
kind = "tags"
indexable = true
reversible = true

[[entities.fields]]
key = "nature"
label = "性味归经"
kind = "text"
immutable = true

[[entities.fields]]
key = "toxicity"
label = "毒性"
kind = "text"
immutable = true

[[entities.fields]]
key = "dosage"
label = "用量"
kind = "text"
immutable = true

[[entities.fields]]
key = "compatibility"
label = "配伍禁忌"
kind = "text"
immutable = true

[[entities.fields]]
key = "decoction"
label = "特殊煎法"
kind = "text"
immutable = true

[[entities.fields]]
key = "differential"
label = "相似药鉴别"
kind = "text"
immutable = true

[[entities.fields]]
key = "processing"
label = "炮制差异"
kind = "text"

[[entities.fields]]
key = "canonical"
label = "教材主表述"
kind = "text"

[[entities.fields]]
key = "synonyms"
label = "可替换说法"
kind = "tags"

[[entities.fields]]
key = "boundary"
label = "不可替换边界"
kind = "text"

[[entities.fields]]
key = "mastery"
label = "掌握度"
kind = "text"

# 个人笔记：白名单里早就有 notes，但以前没在领域包里定义，等于无处可写
[[entities.fields]]
key = "notes"
label = "我的笔记"
kind = "text"
weight = 0.2

# 「替代了哪一条」：新建修订版时写在**新条目**上，指回旧条目
[[entities.fields]]
key = "supersedes"
label = "替代自"
kind = "text"
weight = 0.2

# 反向标记：写在**旧条目**上，指向替代它的新条目。视图靠它隐藏旧版
# （只查新条目的 supersedes 做不到"隐藏旧的"，因为过滤是逐行判定）
[[entities.fields]]
key = "superseded_by"
label = "已被替代为"
kind = "text"
weight = 0.2

# 手工覆盖掌握度的时间戳；30 天内派生值不覆盖用户判断
[[entities.fields]]
key = "mastery_override_at"
label = "掌握度手填时间"
kind = "number"
weight = 0.2

# 「知道部分回答其余」= 给哪些字段、答哪些字段，声明式描述，引擎自动生成反向卡
[[entities.directions]]
id = "name_to_chain"
label = "药名推全链"
clue_fields = ["name"]
answer_fields = ["effects", "indications", "features", "contraindications"]

[[entities.directions]]
id = "effect_to_name"
label = "功效推药名"
clue_fields = ["effects"]
answer_fields = ["name"]
scope = "group_name"
enumerate_if_ambiguous = true

[[entities.directions]]
id = "indication_to_name"
label = "应用推药名"
clue_fields = ["indications"]
answer_fields = ["name", "effects"]
scope = "group_name"
enumerate_if_ambiguous = true

[[entities.directions]]
id = "feature_to_name"
label = "特点推药名"
clue_fields = ["features"]
answer_fields = ["name"]
scope = "group_name"
enumerate_if_ambiguous = true

[[entities.directions]]
id = "contraindication_to_name"
label = "禁忌推药名"
clue_fields = ["contraindications"]
answer_fields = ["name", "features"]
scope = "group_name"
enumerate_if_ambiguous = true

[[aliases]]
concept = "解表药"
canonical = "以发散表邪、解除表证为主要功效"
aliases = ["发散表邪", "解表"]
boundary = "不能写成发汗解肌作总定义"

[[aliases]]
concept = "发汗解表"
canonical = "发汗解表"
aliases = ["发散表邪", "解表"]
boundary = "性味归经、用量、配伍禁忌不合并"

[[views]]
id = "matrix"
label = "药群矩阵"
columns = ["name", "effects", "features", "indications"]
group_by = "group_name"
# 被替代的旧条目不在主视图出现（防止修订版和旧版同时看到、练到）
filter = { field = "superseded_by", op = "eq", value = "" }

[[views]]
id = "danger"
label = "危险区（不合并）"
columns = ["name", "nature", "toxicity", "dosage", "compatibility", "decoction", "differential"]

[[views]]
id = "diff"
label = "考前差异"
columns = ["name", "effects", "features", "contraindications"]
filter = { field = "mastery", op = "ne", value = "熟练" }

[[views]]
id = "superseded"
label = "已被替代"
columns = ["name", "superseded_by", "nature", "dosage"]
filter = { field = "superseded_by", op = "ne", value = "" }

[[views]]
id = "synonyms"
label = "同义表述"
columns = ["name", "canonical", "synonyms", "boundary"]

[[views]]
id = "quiz"
label = "出题视图"
columns = ["name", "effects", "features"]
hidden = ["name", "effects", "features", "contraindications"]

fields.boundary: 性味归经与配伍禁忌不可替换
fields.canonical: 发汗解表温通经脉助阳化气
fields.differential: 与麻黄鉴别在表虚有汗与表实无汗
fields.name: 桂枝

fields.canonical: 疏散风热清利头目利咽透疹疏肝行气
fields.differential: 与荆芥鉴别在辛凉与辛温
fields.name: 薄荷

fields.boundary: 性味归经与用量不可替换
fields.canonical: 发汗解表宣肺平喘利水消肿
fields.differential: 与桂枝鉴别在表实无汗与表虚有汗
fields.name: 麻黄
fields.notes: 发汗力强，表虚者慎用；剂量 2-5g

fields.boundary: 性味归经与用量不可替换
fields.canonical: 发汗解表宣肺平喘利水消肿
fields.differential: 与桂枝鉴别在表实无汗与表虚有汗
fields.name: 麻黄（修订）

fields.canonical: 清热燥湿泻火解毒止血安胎
fields.differential: 与黄连鉴别在上焦与中焦
fields.name: 黄芩
fields.nature: 苦寒归肺胆脾胃大肠小肠经

fields.canonical: 补气升阳固表止汗利水消肿
fields.differential: 与党参鉴别在升阳与健脾
fields.name: 黄芪

fields.boundary: 性味归经与用量不可替换
fields.differential: 与黄芩黄柏鉴别在归经与上中下焦
fields.name: 黄连
fields.nature: 苦寒归心脾胃肝胆大肠经
